spans.s: मेठि m. 1. A pillar; 2. a pillar in the centre of a threshing floor to which oxen are bound; 3. a prop for supporting the shafts of a carriage.
मेथ् vt. or vi. 1U (pres. मेथति-ते) 1. To know, to understand; 2. to hurt, to kill; 3. to meet one another.
मेथिका f. A kind of grass.
